messages.en:
{07 00 00}So I put some fossils on
display in my house!

{07 0a 00}It's like the opening of a
new{01 00 00 05 00} miniature museum,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!

{07 13 00}Guess what!{01 00 00 05 00} I got this
fossil in my room, and it
kinda smells!
{07 00 00}It's the smell of...{01 01 00}history!
{07 0d 00}It's so cool,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
